# Complete resource collection/sample/attribution public owner behavior

No actual execution during authoring/checks. Public paths/command strings are retained compatibility port data, not independently authored PowerShell claim. Default os.cpus() call only if logicalCpuCount nullish; tests always fake it.

Reader windows: at invocation signal?.throwIfAborted(); await execFile powershell.exe args [-NoLogo,-NoProfile,-NonInteractive,-Command,"Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | ForEach-Object { '{0} {1} {2} {3} {4}' -f $_.ProcessId, $_.ParentProcessId, $_.WorkingSetSize, ($_.KernelModeTime + $_.UserModeTime), $_.Name }"] options {timeout:5000,maxBuffer:16777216,windowsHide:true,signal} including undefined signal own key. Truthy result.error->undefined else parse stdout. Promise rejection propagates (do not normalize all errors despite older comments). Rows line LF/CRLF, leading whitespace, first4 digit columns pid,ppid,workingSetBytes,cpu100ns; optional remaining command trimmed. Numbers Number(text), integer>=0 (no safe-integer cap); pid>0. Invalid row skipped. rssKb Math.round(bytes/1024); cpuTimeMs cpu100ns/10000. Keep row order/duplicates. Parsing malformed stdout native errors propagate.

Reader linux: capture readdir option/default at creation. Invocation first throwIfAborted, select options.readFile anew for this call else fs.readFile(path,{encoding:"utf8",signal}); then await readDirectory("/proc") inside catch-all => undefined on rejection/throw. Filter only directory entry strings matching /^\d+$/ (including leading0/zero); for each concurrently in original filtered entry order, try throwIfAborted then concurrently read /proc/entry/stat and /proc/entry/status. Individual throw/rejection/abort skips row, no rereads/fallback. Stat: split at first '(' and LAST ')', pid prefix numeric integer>=0 with pid>0, command contents (spaces/parentheses preserved); suffix whitespace fields state index0,ppid index1,utime11,stime12; integer>=0 all numeric fields; cpuTimeMs Math.round((utime+stime)*1000/100). Invalid stat skips row. Status public parseLinuxVmRssKb: first multiline match line starting VmRSS: then whitespace digit+ whitespace kB, number result, else0. Extra text trailing kB allowed. Missing status file skips whole row, missing VmRSS means0. Empty directory->[]. No post-read abort check in reader beyond per-entry catches.

Other platforms: at invocation throwIfAborted; await execFile("ps",["-axo","pid=,ppid=,rss=,cputime=,comm="],{timeout:3000,maxBuffer:16777216,signal}); truthy error->undefined else rows. Line parser requires pid ppid rss digits, cputime nonspace then at least whitespace and remaining command (may empty). pid>0,integer>=0 others. CPU text trim; optional prefix days before first '-' when index>0, days integer>=0; clock1-3 ':' parts seconds,last;minutes secondlast or0;hours first if3 else0; each Number finite>=0, empty substrings Number("")==0 retained, no60-bound cap. milliseconds Math.round((((days*24+hours)*60+minutes)*60+seconds)*1000). Invalid rows skipped. Command trimmed. Errors from invoked execFile port propagate, no implicit permission changes.

Sampler factory captures now options.now ?? Date.now, logicalCpuCount Math.max(1, options.logicalCpuCount ?? os.cpus().length), per-instance PID CPU baseline only. Each sample calls current options.readTable(signal), then signal?.throwIfAborted BEFORE any baseline mutation; late abort/reject or undefined rows preserves all baselines and does not call now/purge. On rows=[], call now and purge qualifying stale missing PIDs. Each row in order: previous same PID baseline reused ONLY same command, current cpuTimeMs>=baseline.cpuTimeMs, current at>baseline.at; otherwise CPU0. Attribution pure over supplied sample map. Build parent->children in samples.values() insertion order; register owner roots in agents order, each agent root then each reported child; builtinPluginPids entries last override. Starting hostPid visited/excluded, walk child graph depth-first preorder in sibling insertion order, skipvisited cycles/duplicates; sample missing after PID visited means do not walk absent node.
